# Generated by gen_p07.py - do not edit by hand.
source openssl x509 -pubkey | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER | openssl dgst -sha256 (three independent OpenSSL commands)
seed 1
compare records spki=hash
explain _lines=R1
requirement R1 The SPKI hash is correct for several P-256 certificates
requirement R2 The SPKI hash is correct for several P-384 certificates
requirement R3 Two different certificates (different subject, different validity) that share the same public key hash the same - the hash survives reissuance
requirement E2E A small set of certificates mixing both curves and a reissued key, matching OpenSSL's own pipeline bit for bit
